fields.label: Scenario
fields.value: A small number of apparently valid HTTP requests cause high CPU and database load on a search or reporting endpoint.

fields.label: Steps
value: Identify the expensive application path and normal request profile
Measure request rate, latency, query time, and workflow completion
Add route-specific limits, caching, queueing, or computational budgets
Use behavioral signals rather than relying only on source IP addresses
Check legitimate-user completion and adjust thresholds

fields.label: Caveats
value: Do not run an attack against a live third-party endpoint to reproduce the symptom.
Thresholds depend on normal application behavior.
